title: P15.9-B0: full UI/UX redesign master plan — docs only
description: Design-only deliverable per P15.9-B0 mandate (BASE 2232955, post-PR#91). Adds docs/P15_9_B0/: README + A current-UI audit (route inventory, both UIs incl. legacy UI_HTML, UX problems, preservation matrix, EXISTS/API_READY/API_MISSING/FUTURE classification), B information architecture (/app/* parallel sitemap, sidebar hierarchy, route migration map, owner-first nav), C design system (tokens, typography, spacing/breakpoints, component vocabulary, state language incl. UNVERIFIED/DeniedState, a11y), D screen specs + desktop/mobile wireframes, E API-to-UI mapping + API_MISSING register (A2 owner routes, scoped activity feed, aggregate policy state, no multi-tenant claim), F migration strategy (parallel /app routes, no '/' replacement, rollback, no duplicated logic), G PR roadmap B1–B6 + A2 dependency, H acceptance matrix. No UI code, no dependencies, no route/production change. Executable proof: cockpit + met-fold suites unchanged-green (docs don't alter contracts they reference).
